source_inventory_scope.scope: Production View-input VS repair, its41-input regression, current controlled Lighting regressions and nonzero Schema migration only
source_inventory_scope.note: Explicit source inventory taken at the archive UTC interval. Archive-time source snapshots alone do not prove those exact bytes executed in earlier tests. Observed Pipeline/Schema dependency bindings are listed separately.

limitations: Lighting acceptance covers DefaultLit/Unlit ordinary per-light rendering only; not Clustered and not other model BxDFs.
Captured shadow mask, AO and initial HDR are reference fixtures; their native producers are not accepted.
Strict whole-Capture acceptance remains FAILED:31 pixels/31 channels [13,8,10,0], each one half ULP. No tolerance relaxation or variant selection by residual count.
The41 exact PS inputs are selected probes from RenderDoc instrumented initial inputs, not full-allocation or uninstrumented interpolation proof.
Schema migration compares each mesh/adapter path to itself under two nonzero lights. It is not cross-path equality or an independent BRDF oracle.

Direct six-case report does not record per-NPZ digests; their archive-time hashes and population checks do not establish original runtime NPZ identity. Migration and production NPZ evidence has recorded hash binding.

Build/170 offline/4 CPU logs are preserved and markers verified; logs do not include independent source/runtime digest attestations. Runtime identity instead comes from GPU reports and observed Pipeline baselines.
Rejected candidate Pipeline paths were not observed after rollback. Declared Schema/input files are archived without inventing surviving runtime Pipeline identities.

Historical proof runtime differs from current. Prior acceptance files are read through their frozen CAS; old DLL bytes were not included in that prior archive. No current-DLL authentication of old GPU runs.
This CAS preserves current runtime binaries/shader tree but does not make external OS, driver, importer runtime or the entire RDC file reproducible.
Point-from-Decode placement is not an exact-coincidence rejection proof; synthetic geometry tests do not cover all internal BRDF degeneracies.
SSR, TSR, Web, other passes and full renderer equivalence remain incomplete.
